mutation_boundary: Only this receipt written; no source/workflow edits, provider execution, secrets, commit, push or deployment.

workflow_findings.finding: workflow_run listens only to Unified CI & Quality Audit Pipeline; job checks success/main branch; exact event SHA selected and checkout verified.
workflow_dispatch on main proceeds without checking any upstream workflow outcome; SHA validation alone does not establish CI approval.
Unified CI includes lint/security and test provenance (line198), plus Rust, pytest, reviewer and production E2E; no ecosystem job and no dependency on separate AI Safety Audit workflow.
AI Safety push paths filter omits docs/tests-only commits, so requiring a same-SHA safety run also requires removing this filter or explicitly running unconditional equivalent safety job.
permissions only contents:read; remote workflow verification requires narrowly adding actions:read.

minimum_safe_workflow_fix.recommended: Before packaging/publication, gate both workflow_run and workflow_dispatch through exact selected-SHA workflow evidence for all required workflows. A trusted checked-in verifier plus workflow wiring can isolate the policy for offline unit tests.
acceptance: Query workflows by trusted file identity, not ambiguous job display names.
Require exact source SHA, repository, main branch and trusted push event for each required run.
Use latest run/attempt; require completed and success. Reject missing, pending, cancelled, skipped, timed_out, failure and API errors.
Reject stale source by comparing current main to selected source before publish.
Run gate before provider mutation in both entry paths.
Remove AI Safety push path filter so every main candidate receives a run.
If Unified CI completes before other workflows, fail closed with diagnostic or bounded polling; do not silently publish.
Record sanitized workflow IDs/run IDs/attempts/SHA/conclusions in release evidence.
tests: All required exact-SHA runs green permits gate.
Old successful run cannot mask latest failed attempt.
API failures and duplicate ambiguous identity deny.

blockers.finding: devops nested agent.json missing HF Static Release Gate Owner marker; other three release owners have markers. Devops also advertises Azure primary/ACA rollback contrary to HF Docker/Vercel skills.
blockers.fix: Use owned canonical definition update, retaining compatibility marker and enforcing canonical target semantics; regenerate mirrors afterward. Never repair only generated YAML/TOML.

blockers.finding: Validator flags every root plans/*.md except plan.md. Some flagged documents describe active READY/BLOCKED tasks, not completed plans.
blockers.fix: Classify lifecycle truth. Move active supporting docs into an active subdirectory and update references; archive only completed/superseded artifacts with accurate status and index. Alternative semantic validator fix needs owned tests.

blockers.finding: sync_sdlc_agents.py --check --use-python exits1 with108 generated agent/skill drift findings; sync_codex_agents.py --check exits1 with20 stale TOML roles.
blockers.fix: After canonical source freeze run python3 scripts/sync_ai_agent_ecosystem.py --sync, review generated diff, then --check. No generated-file hand edits.

blockers.finding: codex3 missing8 disabled remote plugin entries and20 inert profiles; prompt3394 chars is within8000 budget.
blockers.fix: Canonical account config sync regenerates inert local profiles and policy; no remote provider invocation. Aggregate ecosystem --sync invokes it. Separate validation: python3 scripts/sync_codex_account_configs.py --check --budget.

currently_green: 5 scoped AGENTS files and line budgets

release_sequence: Reviewed isolated RED baseline commit with only exact authorized tests/provenance.
Owned source fixes and independent isolated/combined QA plus provenance.
Reviewed canonical governance/plan reconciliation then generated sync.
Implement and independently test exact-SHA CI gate before main push.
Fresh security review, publisher dry-run and release metadata/rollback identity checks.
Push only reviewed exact scope and inspect actual remote checks for resulting SHA.
Publish HF Docker and separately verify Vercel identities, health, E2E and five canonical viewports; never infer deployment success from push.
unverified: Remote current CI/branch-protection settings not queried.
Production provider revisions/rollback anchors/live identity not queried.
Runtime QA/source remediation owned by other lanes.
